name: SpotlightCard
description: A card with a soft light that follows the pointer. The light is off for touch and for visitors who ask for less motion, and the card keeps its own focus ring.

size.description: Radius of the light in pixels.

color.description: Colour of the light, any CSS colour. Defaults to the primary action colour.

requirements: The light is decoration: aria-hidden, behind the content and never blocks the pointer
Off for touch pointers, for reduced motion, inside rdm-still and with isPaused
Content and its contrast do not depend on the light: the light is a faint tint under the text
Any focusable child keeps its own visible focus ring: the card never replaces or hides it
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the light is removed
screenReader: Read as ordinary content: the light is not announced

use_when: A grid of tiles that should feel responsive to the pointer
avoid_when: Cards that must be perfectly flat in a dense table
anti_patterns: Putting text colours that only pass contrast over the brightest part of the light
Hiding the focus ring of a link inside the card
